purpose: Bind the existing FineWeb-Edu control and Ultra-FineWeb HQ candidate evidence for the bounded pretraining web contrast.
evidence_boundary: This manifest records retained inventory and bounded comparison evidence only. It does not establish rights, eligible supply, population-wide quality, contamination clearance or training authority.

common_contract.transformation_type: natural_source_records; no generated rewrites admitted by this manifest
common_contract.source_family: FineWeb-Edu and Ultra-FineWeb HQ remain separate source families until the joint graph is frozen
common_contract.quality_vector: Retain source score distributions, extraction/review flags and coverage strata; no new cutoff is selected here.
common_contract.dependency_metadata: Not required for this natural-web contrast; long-context dependency fields remain open for context-specific manifests.
common_contract.contamination_status: open; benchmark-family joins and evaluation firewall are not complete.
common_contract.lineage: Bind source revision/configuration, retained manifest and processing receipt before admission.
common_contract.unique_tokens: Report raw, retained, exact-unique, cross-source-distinct and eligible tokens separately.
common_contract.exposure_tokens: not set; frozen only after source gates and common-horizon cost qualification.
common_contract.repetition_count: not set; automatic repetition is prohibited.

identity.revision: not pinned in current source-readiness matrix
identity.configuration: retained FineWeb-Edu stock; exact release/configuration decision open

identity.route: pinned HQ/L1 candidate route; cutoff and review flags unchanged

blockers: full-shard eligible-token census under frozen exclusions

measured_overlap.interpretation: A bounded exact-overlap accounting result; it does not close family, semantic-near-duplicate, rights, quality or eligible-supply gates.

comparison_contract.contrast: FineWeb-Edu control versus Ultra-FineWeb HQ candidate at one fixed natural-web bank share.
not_allowed: repairing extraction in only one arm
using retained counts as eligible supply
comparison_contract.study_slot: pretraining screening web_bank_candidate; one of at most three screening interventions

required_before_screening: Named source-use and notice decision for both candidates.
Pinned FineWeb-Edu release/configuration and complete joint family/benchmark graph.
Source-aware quality and extraction decision with coverage strata and accepted/rejected accounting.
Benchmark contamination firewall and held-out evaluation families.
Eligible unique-token counts sufficient for the common horizon.
Measured GH200 cost and common comparison horizon.
next_actions: Resolve the FineWeb-Edu release/configuration identity and source-use decision.
Extend exact overlap into the joint family/near-duplicate and benchmark graph.
Turn review flags into an explicit source-aware extraction decision without silently changing the HQ cutoff.
Compute eligible tokens after exclusions and preserve the distinct-token overlap bound.
Keep both candidates outside the study arm until a revised source-readiness receipt closes the gates.
admission_boundary: This is a launch-blocked candidate manifest. It does not admit either web source, authorize acquisition or change the pretraining study budget.
